pm_mode_enabled.checkpoint: before executeHedge() registers the supplied 0x811 slot

hedge_asset_whitelisted.meaning: Governor has whitelisted the hedge asset
hedge_asset_whitelisted.checkpoint: before executeHedge() registers the supplied 0x811 slot

supplied_slot_active.meaning: the 0x811 supplied slot is actually active on HyperCore
supplied_slot_active.checkpoint: before executeHedge() registers the supplied 0x811 slot

settlement_flows_frozen.meaning: critical accounting and settlement flows are frozen (settlement cannot evaluate distributable surplus because total backing read reverts)
settlement_flows_frozen.checkpoint: after executeHedge() registers the supplied 0x811 slot and settlement reads total backing

assumptions: The supplied 0x811 slot is registered by executeHedge() before HyperCore activates it, so the slot is inactive at the strict backing read.
The freeze manifests as a revert of the total backing read that halts settlement; the report does not tie it to a specific transaction checkpoint.

unresolved.description: Report does not tie the later totalBackingSigned() read to a specific transaction, so the settlement-read checkpoint is symbolic.

limitations: Impact is potential: the freeze is formalized only under the report-supported conditional scenario where the supplied slot is not yet active.
No numeric amounts or bounds are given for the supplied slot or backing values; the relation is qualitative.
